Name: Islands Farm
Author: Draylon
Description:
A Huge chain of islands that Unlock as you Complete Community Center(or Joja) Bundles. [See Larger Text Below to skip to full unlock]
~One of the Pictures has the Order They Unlock in
~One of the Pictures has the Default Placement of the Farmhouse, Greenhouse, Close Cabins (In Purple), and Far Cabins (In Red) on it.
~One of the Pictures has a Pixel Accurate Size Comparison to the "Standard Farm"

Features
~Progressive Unlocking Islands
~A Shortcut Warp (The Boats travel to each other, One below the quarry island, one below the farmhouse island, Unlocked upon Completion of Bundle 6)
~A Quarry (Unlocked on Completion of Bundle 4)
~Beach Forage Will spawn on the wet sand
~Beach Crates Will wash up on wet sand.
~Blue Grass (Unlocked on Completion of Bundle 5 & 6)
~A Hidden Cellar that you can place Casks in near the exit to town. (Unlocks on Completion of Bundle 6 [Base Game Community Center Complete])

~Sprinklers will not work on the Beach! I figure there is enough space otherwise to allow for this thematically.


[size=4]Now Has a Config for those who want to just unlock the Whole Thing, Just Change it from "Progressive" to "Unlocked"
[/size]It tracks how much you've unlocked regardless of what setting it is on, so if you play on Unlocked and Finish a Bundle, and Go To Progressive, you will still have access to the 1 Bundle Complete Islands.

It Should be compatible with almost everything, only exception would be anything directly modifies the farm map itself. (Recolors will work fine)

Installation is just drop it in your mods folder along with its prerequisites
